rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a street in a town or city.

example.english: This street is lively even at night.
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 gaai1 je6 maan5 dou1 hou2 jit6 naau6

rows.note: Use this when the street is being viewed more broadly as a road or route, including in street names.

example.english: Follow this street and you will reach the MTR station.
example.traditional: 沿住呢條路行就到地鐵站。
example.jyutping: jyun4 zyu6 ni1 tiu4 lou6 haang4 zau6 dou3 dei6 tit3 zaam6
